#.label: Tenders (preview)
#.description: Preview of the new tender configuration, for trying out the form in the Config Portal. Store Data does not deliver it to the stores. Payment methods (tenders) accepted at the point of sale. Choose the tender type first: only the settings that make sense for that type are offered, and every setting left empty uses the default for the type. Store Data adds every technical setting the point of sale needs (payment plugins, provider codes, currency) and delivers the list to the stores. The 'id' identifies a tender and must be unique in the list.
#/items/properties/id.label: Tender ID
#/items/properties/id.description: Unique code of this tender, 1 to 4 capital letters, digits, '-' or '_'. The point of sale stores at most 4 characters. Transactions, reports and ERP integrations reference it, so never reuse or rename it: renaming creates a new tender. Examples: 'CASH', 'VISA', 'SWSH'. Loyalty redemption and loyalty gift certificates must use the payment code of the loyalty system.
#/items/properties/type.label: Tender Type
#/items/properties/type.description: What kind of payment this is. Choose it first: the other settings depend on it. Changing the type of a tender that is already in use makes Store Data replace the tender at every store.
#/items/properties/type/properties/hardw: How cash is taken. A cash changer machine counts the cash and pays out change by itself, and the till must also have the cash changer enabled. A cash changer tender cannot be the default cash tender: a store with one also needs a cash tender with a cash drawer as its default, for tills without a machine. A cash changer works only when the store's own currency has two decimals. Empty means cash drawer.
#/items/properties/type/properties/termi: How the terminal is connected. An integrated terminal receives the amount from the till; its payment provider is set up for the store and checkout in Hii Connect, not here. On a standalone terminal the cashier types the amount.
#/items/properties/type/properties/integ: Integrated: the till sends the payment request to the customer's app; this works only when every amount on the sale has at most two decimals, so not in a currency with three decimals. Standalone: the cashier checks the payment by hand; such payments cannot be refunded at the till.
#/items/properties/type/properties/provi: The mobile payment service. Required when integrated, ignored when standalone. Swish works only in SEK. The provider's credentials are set up for the tenant by Extenda Retail.
#/items/properties/type/properties/credi: When on, the till checks the business customer on the sale and their credit limit before accepting the tender. When off, the tender is accepted without any customer or credit check.
#/items/properties/currency.label: Currency
#/items/properties/currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the foreign currency, for example 'EUR'. Required for foreign currency cash, and ignored for every other type, which uses the store's own currency. It must be one of the currencies configured for the stores and differ from the store's own currency.
#/items/properties/name.label: Display Name
#/items/properties/name.description: Shown on the till and printed on receipts. Examples: 'Cash', 'Visa / Mastercard', 'Swish'.
#/items/properties/description.label: Internal Description
#/items/properties/description.descripti: Note for administrators. Not shown to cashiers or customers.
#/items/properties/disabled.label: Disabled
#/items/properties/disabled.description: Removes the tender from the stores but keeps its configuration here, so it can be enabled again. A disabled tender cannot be the change tender of another tender.
#/items/properties/restrictionRuleId.des: Id of the item restriction rule that limits which items this tender can pay for. Required for food stamps and WIC checks. The kind that holds these rules is not available yet, so food stamp and WIC tenders are not delivered to the stores until it is.
#/items/properties/behavior.label: At the Till
#/items/properties/behavior.description: How the till handles this tender. Every setting is optional: a setting left empty uses the default for the tender type.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/d: The till uses the default tender of a type when a payment names only the type, and the default cash tender decides the store's change and cash rounding. Automatic (default): this tender becomes the default when no enabled tender of its type is set to 'Yes' and it is the only enabled one of its type not set to 'No'. Cash changer tenders are left out of this count and are never the default cash tender. When a type has several enabled tenders, set 'Yes' on exactly one of them, or 'No' on all but one. Foreign currency is the exception: with several foreign currency tenders the till always asks the cashier which currency, and Yes only pre-selects that currency in the list, so none has to be Yes.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/e: When on, the customer cannot pay more than the amount due, so no change is given. When off (default), the customer can hand over more and gets change. Only for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers and checks; every other type always takes the exact amount, and the setting is ignored for them.

When on, this tender must pay the whole amount due on its own: no other tender may be on the sale, and it always takes the exact amount, whatever 'Exact Amount Only' says. A tender with a fixed value, such as a gift certificate, voucher or coupon, can then only be used when its value equals the amount due.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/l: When on, no items can be added, changed or discounted once this tender is entered, and the sale cannot be suspended. The sale can still be completed, the tender line voided, or the sale cancelled. On types where 'Block Cancelling the Sale' is offered (gift certificates, vouchers, checks, coupons, manufacturer coupons, house accounts, food stamps, WIC checks and organization charge without credit check), the two cannot both be on: the sale would then be stuck until it is paid in full.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/b: When on, a sale that contains this tender cannot be cancelled and the tender line cannot be voided; the sale can only be completed. Ignored for cash, foreign currency, cards, mobile payments, electronic gift cards, loyalty points and organization charge with credit check: after money has been taken the cashier must always have a way back. Where it applies, it cannot be on together with 'Lock Sale After Payment Entry'.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/p: When on and no amount is given, the till uses the full remaining amount and skips the amount prompt. Intended for terminals and unmanned checkouts. Ignored for foreign currency, where the till would then accept only the exact converted amount and could give no change; for gift certificates, vouchers, coupons, manufacturer coupons and loyalty points, which pay their own value; and for cash (a cash changer tender always takes the full remaining amount).
When on, the amount prompt on interactive tills starts with the remaining amount instead of zero.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/c: Whether the cash drawer opens when a sale paid with this tender is completed. Type default: opens for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers, checks, coupons and manufacturer coupons, which go into the drawer, and stays closed for every other type. Choose 'Open the drawer' for paper food stamps and WIC checks; electronic benefit cards need no drawer. Change given in cash always opens the drawer.
#/items/properties/change.label: Change
#/items/properties/change.description: Where change goes when the customer pays more than the amount due. Leave empty to give all change in the store's default cash tender. Only for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers and checks that do not take the exact amount; ignored otherwise.
#/items/properties/change/properties/ten: Id of the tender that pays change instead of cash, for example a gift certificate that issues the remainder as a new certificate. It may be this tender itself. It must be an enabled cash, foreign currency, gift certificate or voucher tender in this list that allows refunds and has no minimum amounts.
#/items/properties/change/properties/thr: Change above this amount goes to the alternate change tender; this amount or less is given in cash. Leave empty to send all change to the alternate change tender. Ignored without an alternate change tender.
#/items/properties/change/properties/aut: Change below this amount is given automatically. Change of this amount or more must be handled by the cashier before the sale completes. Leave empty to always give change automatically.
#/items/properties/refund.label: Refunds
#/items/properties/refund.description: Whether money can go back to the customer with this tender, and the limits for it. Leave empty to allow refunds without limits. Ignored for checks, coupons, manufacturer coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, loyalty points and standalone mobile payments, which can never refund.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/blo: When on, this tender cannot be used when money goes back to the customer; the cashier must choose another tender. Cash always allows refunds, because change is paid out as a cash refund; the setting is ignored for cash.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/ski: Skip Amount Prompt on Receipt Refunds
When on, a refund against the original receipt refunds the remaining amount of this tender without asking the cashier for an amount.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/max: Largest amount that can go back to the customer in one entry with this tender. Above it, a manager must approve. On cash this also limits change. Leave empty for no limit. Ignored when refunds are blocked.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/min: Smallest amount that can go back to the customer in one entry with this tender. Must not be larger than the maximum. Ignored for cash, where it would block change. Leave empty for no minimum.
#/items/properties/limits.label: Amount Limits
#/items/properties/limits.description: Limits on how much can be paid with this tender. Leave a limit empty for no limit.
#/items/properties/limits/properties/max: Largest total that can be paid with this tender in one sale, over all its entries.
Largest amount for a single entry of this tender.
#/items/properties/limits/properties/min: Smallest amount for a single entry of this tender, including change and refunds paid with it. A remaining amount below it cannot be paid with this tender. Must not be larger than the maximums. Ignored for cash, where it would block change.
#/items/properties/rounding.label: Cash Rounding
#/items/properties/rounding.description: Rounds amounts paid with this tender to the smallest coin in use, for example 0.05. Leave empty, or choose 'No rounding', for no rounding. Only for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers and checks; ignored otherwise.
#/items/properties/rounding/properties/m: Whether amounts are rounded, and which way an amount exactly between two units goes.
#/items/properties/rounding/properties/p: The smallest unit amounts are rounded to. Amounts the cashier types must be a multiple of it. It must not be smaller than the smallest unit of the store's currency. Ignored without a rounding method or with 'No rounding'.
#/items/properties/extraAttributes.label: Extra Attributes
#/items/properties/extraAttributes.descr: Only use when Extenda Retail support asks for it. Each entry is identified by its name ('id'). Names starting with 'Pos.' are advanced point-of-sale settings that this form does not offer, for example manager overrides of limits or account number capture; Store Data rejects names that duplicate a setting in this form. Other names are passed to point-of-sale extensions.
